## Chillscreen: keeps playing with the screen locked
- **Next song plays when locked:** with the chillscreen open and the phone locked (or the app in the background), the next song now starts right away. Before, it waited for the record change animation, which only runs while the screen is on
- When you unlock, the room catches up and shows the new record

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Android:** Settings → Updates → Update now
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates, or run the new installer
- **Linux:** Settings → Updates
